content: Abraame Xeygeteth
GODAY Abraame, «Ne dereppe, ne dabbotappenne ne aawa keeththa asaappe shaakettada tani nena bessiza biitta ba.
Abraamey GODAY izas yootida mala dendi bides; Looxeykka izara bides; Abraamey Kaaraane dereppe bishin izas layththay laapun tammanne ichchasha.
Abraamey ba machchiyo Soora, ba isha naa Looxe, Kaaraanen istti demmida aylletanne heen shiishshida bantta aqota ubbaa ekkidi Kanaane biitta bides.
Abraamey he biittan Seekeemen Moore geetettizason diza gita miththaako gakkanaas bides; he wode Kanaane asati he biittan deettes.
GODAY Abraames qonccidi, «Ha biittaa tani ne zereththas immana» gides; izi baas qonccida GODAAS he sohon yarsho yarshizaso keexxidi goynnides.

Hessafe dendidi Beeteleppe arshey mokkiza baggara diza zumatizaso biidi heen Beetele arshey wulliza baggan aggidi qasse Aye geetettiza katama arshey mokkiza bagga aggidi giddon ba dunkaane tolides; heenkka GODAAS yarsho yarshizaso keexxidi GODAA sunththaa xeygides.
Hessafe guye Abraamey heeppe dendi biidi Negebe
geetettiza bazzo gakkides.
Gibxe Abraame Buus
He wode Kanaane biittan koshay dendiin koshazi keehi iita gidida gishshas Abraamey kosha wode aaththanaas duge Gibxe wodhdhides.
Gibxe gelana hanishin Abraamey ba machchiyo Soora, «Siya! Ne daro mala lo7o maccas gididayssa ta erays.
Gibxe asay nena be7iza wode isttas, ‹Hanna iza machcho› giidi nena aggidi tana wodhana.
Hessa gishshas istti taas ne gaason kiyana malanne qasse ne gaason ta hayqqontta attana mala neni, ‹Ta izas michcho› ga» gides.
Abraamey Gibxe biitta gelida wode Gibxe asati he maccassaya daro mala lo7o maccas gididayssa be7ida.
Qasse Gibxe kawos ooththiza halaqatikka izo be7idi kawo sinththan izo nashshida; histtidi izo kawoso efida.
Histtiin izi geedon kawoy Abraame lo7o ayfen xeellidi Abraames dorsatanne boorata, adde haretanne macca hareta, adde aylletanne macca aylleta, gaamellatakka immides.
Gido attiin GODAY Abraame machcheyo Soora geedon Gibxe kawo bollanne izaso asaa bolla bosha yeddides.
Histtiin kawozi Abraame xeygidi, «Neni hayssa ays ta bolla ooththadii? Iza ne machcho gididayssa ays taas yootabeekkii?
Ta izo machcho ekkana mala, ‹Iza ta michcho› gaada aazas wordotadii? Hekko hanno ne machcheyo ekkada ba!» gides.
Kawozikka ba aylleta Abraame iza machcheyranne izas dizaaz ubbaa kessidi yeddana mala azaziin aylleti istta dereppe kessi yeddida.
